boundaries: Foundry Claude uses JSON prompting plus strict local Draft 2020-12 validation; native provider JSON Schema is not claimed.
Prompt-cache controls and usage accounting are wired, but this acceptance observed zero cache read/write tokens and makes no savings claim.
Durable idempotency provides first-writer-wins effect reservation; universal exactly-once behavior for arbitrary external systems is not claimed.

Context admission uses a fail-closed upper bound of one token per UTF-8 byte plus framing and a 22,000-token reserve per validated image when no exact provider tokenizer is available; it may reject usable context rather than undercount.
Context provenance describes the initial effective context; per-model-call provenance remains future hardening.
Runtime, RAG and verifier operations use absolute deadlines; terminal persistence has a separate bounded cleanup and logs an indeterminate state if it cannot finish.
The embedding deployment is a development Azure Foundry GlobalStandard deployment, not a production SLA claim.
